text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana her answer in our direct message. Moss's notes give two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

1. #PD-4492, from Moss's Sunday prep note for Ruth (5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text-message bay assignments at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift was fine. Moss also noted the Eau Claire kiosk logs should be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.

2. #4419, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet. Thea logged it because the gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to second-tier support to test the scanner firmware.

Moss's other two North notes (14 Sep 2025 and 23 Mar 2026) mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers. His Central notes have tickets (#4409, #4412, FR-882), but those are for other accounts. All four North notes are files Dana can open herself.

I also warned her about a mismatch: a 14 Jul 2025 note by Marcus Lindqvist (not Moss) uses #4419 for Quarrendon but calls it a printer delay at Gate 3, not a scanner problem. I suggested she check with support before putting it in the weekly notes.

The company knowledge base turned up more Quarrendon ticket numbers, but none came from Moss and some were in places Dana may not have access to, so I left them out.
